slot: Custom cake / bakery business taking orders by DM and WhatsApp
name: Baked by Nataleen
trade: Custom cakes, desserts, catering and baking courses
location: Pretoria North, Pretoria (also Polokwane for courses)
why_wave: Founder-led bakery whose own site names the founder and lists a contact form, email and WhatsApp for orders.
one_line_pitch: Turn your photo-heavy cake enquiries into a tidy catalogue and a shop link with clear prices, with alerts when someone wants to order, so enquiries are not lost between DMs and WhatsApp.

public_facts.fact: The website presents the business as offering custom cakes, desserts, catering and confectionery courses.

The website's About text names Nataleen Vorster as the brainchild of the business and says she runs the kitchen; it says she first brought her baking skills to the Pioneer Museum's Boeremarket in 2009.
The website lists an online shop and cart, a contact form, a sales email address, a phone number and a WhatsApp link, and the address 135 Erich Mayer Street, Pretoria North.
The birthday cakes page says delivery is to Pretoria, Centurion, Pretoria East and elsewhere in Gauteng at a fee, and lists cakes and cupcakes priced from R180 up to R5,395.
The contact page lists a sales email address, a phone number, a link to a contact form and the business address; its deposit wording (50% non-refundable) is in the class-booking terms.

The Instagram bio (summariser-only) describes custom and themed cakes or cupcakes for birthday parties and special occasions, weekday opening hours, a WhatsApp/phone number, and links to the website and a Linktree.
Instagram (summariser-only) shows highlights for birthday, wedding and baby shower cakes, cupcakes, cakesicles and party combos, and posts dated up to 2026-09-25, with a September specials promotion.

businesses.name: Baked by Nataleen baking courses
businesses.what: confectionery classes in Pretoria and Polokwane

channels_observed: Website with online shop, contact form, email, phone and WhatsApp (bakedbynataleen.co.za)
Instagram @bakedbynataleen with a WhatsApp number and Linktree in the bio
Facebook page listed on the contact page
decision_maker: Founder and head baker, Chef Nataleen Vorster (named on the business's own website).

approach.route: Website contact form, or the sales email published on the site, as a single human-written message.
approach.opening_message: Hi Nataleen, I'm from FluxMuse, a new South African company that helps small food businesses handle WhatsApp orders. I noticed your site offers cakes, catering and courses, with orders by form, email, phone and WhatsApp. That looks like a lot of doors into one business. We are opening with a small first group and setting up by hand. Could we have a 20-minute call? If this isn't relevant, reply STOP and I won't contact you again.
approach.compliance_note: A single relevant business message sent through the enquiry form and email the business publishes, with an opt-out, is a defensible one-to-one approach under POPIA s69; it is not legal advice.

pains.pain: Cake enquiries can reach you across your form, email, phone and WhatsApp, so a photo request could be answered late or lost.
pains.evidence: cake businesses often take enquiries on several channels. Your site lists a form, email, phone and WhatsApp link, and your Instagram bio adds another route. We do not know whether any enquiries are actually missed.
pains.validate_with: Which channel do most cake requests arrive on, and how do you make sure none get missed?

pains.pain: Custom cakes need a design, size, date and deposit agreed before baking, and this back-and-forth is long and repeated for each order.
pains.evidence: this is common in custom cake trades, and your contact page mentions a deposit to secure bookings.
pains.validate_with: What details do you have to ask every customer before you can quote, and how long does that usually take?

pains.pain: You offer catering and courses beside cakes, which may mean one small team switches between very different enquiries.
pains.evidence: your site lists custom cakes, catering and confectionery courses. We do not know how big your team is.
pains.validate_with: Which of the three lines takes most of your enquiry time?

pains.pain: You produce lots of photo content, but only some of it may turn into shareable, priced, ready-to-order items.
pains.evidence: your Instagram shows many cake categories and party bundles. We did not check whether each one has a current price online.
pains.validate_with: Do customers ask for the price of designs they saw on Instagram, and how often?

fit.reasoning: The business is founder-led, has a published route to her, and clearly spans many enquiry channels and product lines. Poor-fit risks: she already runs an online shop and website, so she may consider the problem solved; the value of a shop link is limited for one-off custom designs that need a personal quote; and shop checkout is still in setup, so orders arrive as a WhatsApp message.

recommended_plan.why: You run one kitchen and one brand. Micro adds one WhatsApp number and the extra channels without paying for multi-brand plans.
recommended_plan.upgrade_path: If catering or courses become a separate brand with its own number, a bigger plan would be worth reviewing together.

what_we_would_do.for_them: Send photos of your standard cakes, cupcakes, cakesicles and party packs on WhatsApp. The AI drafts names, descriptions and a price guess, and you confirm or correct each one. Newly launched, no business has run it end to end yet, so we would do the first batch together.
A single link to your ready-made range with prices, for Instagram and WhatsApp. Customers who want something custom tap through and the request arrives as a pre-typed WhatsApp message to you.
A WhatsApp alert for each request and a SOLD reply once a deposit is confirmed, so your open enquiries are visible in one place.

what_we_would_do.capability: WhatsApp Business setup: quick replies and templates
what_we_would_do.for_them: Quick replies for lead times, delivery areas and what you need from a customer (date, servings, flavour, design photo), so you do not type the same questions each time.

what_we_would_do.capability: AI captions and images for posts (POST keyword)
what_we_would_do.for_them: Photo in, caption and cleaned-up image back on WhatsApp, ready to forward to WhatsApp Status for your seasonal party bundles.

what_we_would_do.capability: Auto-publishing to Facebook Pages and Instagram
what_we_would_do.for_them: Meta approvals are not in yet, so until then your posts go to WhatsApp Status. We would not rely on it.

actions: 20-minute call to map how a cake enquiry travels from first message to paid deposit
Choose 8 to 12 ready-to-order products for your catalogue
Send those photos through the Concierge and confirm each price
Publish your shop link and add it to your Instagram and WhatsApp profile
Write quick replies for lead times, delivery and the info you need for a custom quote
Test the order alert with two dummy orders
Use the POST keyword for one seasonal offer and forward it to WhatsApp Status
Mark real orders SOLD after deposits are confirmed
Start a consented customer list for cake-season reminders
Review together how many enquiries came from the link and how many still needed back-and-forth
Adjust your catalogue, prices and quick replies
Decide whether to continue, based on what we measured

we_would_track: WhatsApp conversations started from your shop link
Enquiries that arrive with the design, date and servings already stated
Time you spend per enquiry before a quote is sent

objections.objection: I already have a website and an online shop.
objections.response: Yes, and we would not replace it. FluxMuse focuses on the WhatsApp side: getting photos into a catalogue quickly, alerts when someone enquires, and quick replies for the questions you answer every time.

objections.objection: Custom cakes cannot go in a shop; every order is different.
objections.response: Agreed for bespoke designs. The link is for your standard items and as a clean way to start a custom conversation, so the customer arrives with size, date and design already filled in.

objections.objection: I don't have time to learn another tool.
objections.response: You would send photos on WhatsApp and reply YES or NO, and we set it up by hand. We are new and are working with a small first group, so we would rather do the work with you than hand you a manual.

gaps: The contact page still carries older class rules (such as masks) and the homepage carries a Black Friday banner; the deposit wording is about class bookings and was not confirmed for cakes.
Parts of the site look out of date; current trading rests on Instagram posts dated 2026-09-14 to 2026-09-25 (summariser-only, since Instagram serves a login shell to raw fetches).
Instagram follower count and highlight names are summariser-only and are not used beyond what is listed.
Whether she uses WhatsApp Business, and how many staff she has, is unknown.
